docs.title: Documentation
docs.lead: Everything you need to build with the @ezstart platform: SDK quickstarts, API references, and integration guides.
docs.ezauthBody: Authentication, sessions, OAuth, API keys, and role-based access control. The identity layer powering every @ezstart application.
docs.ezpayBody: Universal payment system: donations, one-time purchases, subscriptions, and Stripe Connect for multi-vendor marketplaces.
docs.uiBody: Headless React component library: layouts, typography, forms, data display, and feedback. Themed via CSS tokens, dark mode included.
docs.githubBody: All packages are open source under the MIT license. Read the source, file an issue, or contribute on GitHub.

about.title: About EZStart
about.leadHeading: The platform hub powering EZAuth, EZPay, and a portfolio of consumer apps
about.leadBody: EZStart is a TypeScript monorepo and platform hub that ships production-grade SaaS services (authentication, payments, AI gateway) and the consumer applications that dogfood them. Everything is published under the MIT license so any team can adopt the same primitives.
about.missionBody: We believe modern SaaS infrastructure should be open, type-safe, and effortlessly composable. EZStart packages the building blocks we wished existed when we started: agnostic SDKs, batteries-included Next.js apps, and a single design system that works across every product.
about.platformBody: EZAuth (identity), EZPay (payments), @ezstart/ui (design system), @ezstart/ai-sdk (AI gateway), plus consumer apps like EZBill, GreenPulse, and FengShui — all in one monorepo, all dogfooding the same SaaS services.
about.ctaBody: Browse the documentation or contact us to discuss your use case.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.leadBody: Need help integrating an @ezstart SDK, reporting an issue, or discussing your use case? We typically reply within one business day.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summaryBody: EZStart respects your privacy. As the platform hub, we collect minimal data — primarily what is required for authentication via EZAuth and basic site analytics. Detailed data handling for paid services is governed by the EZAuth and EZPay privacy policies.
privacy.scopeBody: Aggregated, anonymous traffic analytics via Vercel Analytics. Authentication data is collected by EZAuth on our behalf — see the EZAuth privacy policy for details. We never sell personal data.
privacy.contactBody: Reach out to us if you need details about how your data is processed.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summaryBody: EZStart is provided on an as-is basis while we finalize our terms with our legal team. The full terms of service will be published before the public launch.
terms.useBody: By using EZStart you agree to follow applicable laws, to not abuse the platform or its hosted services, and to keep your credentials secure. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these principles.
terms.contactBody: Reach out to us with any question about these terms.

pricing.title: Platform pricing
pricing.lead: EZStart itself is the platform hub — free and open source. The SaaS services it powers each have their own pricing.
pricing.ezauthBody: Authentication-as-a-service: free tier for hobby projects, paid plans for production traffic and advanced features (2FA mandatory, audit logs, white-label theming).
pricing.ezpayBody: Payments-as-a-service: pay-as-you-go on top of Stripe fees, no monthly minimums. Free during the public beta period.
pricing.openSourceBody: Every package in the @ezstart monorepo is published under the MIT license. Self-host any service for free, or pay for the hosted version when you want zero-ops.
